name: BrewDesk — Cafe & Barista Ops
description: A cafe operations hub: take dine-in and takeaway orders, run the barista queue, track beans and milk stock, manage the roster, and close out the day. Includes 6 forms and 1 app.

packMeta.name: BrewDesk — Cafe & Barista Ops
packMeta.description: A cafe operations hub: take dine-in and takeaway orders, run the barista queue, keep beans and milk stocked to par, roster the crew, and ring off the daily close — all linked together.
packMeta.author: FormLogic

forms.title: Menu Item
forms.description: Add a drink, dish or retail line to the menu with its price, station and dietary tags.

fields.label: New Menu Item
fields.description: Put something new on the board: name it, price it and point it at the right station.

forms.title: Cafe Order
forms.description: Take a dine-in, takeaway or delivery order and track it from new to served.

fields.label: New Cafe Order
fields.description: Take the order, note the table or takeaway, and send it to the service board.

forms.title: Barista Ticket
forms.description: Call a drink onto the coffee rail with its milk, size, shots and extras.

fields.label: New Barista Ticket
fields.description: Call the drink: type, milk, size and shots. It lands on the rail in order.

forms.title: Stock Item
forms.description: Track a pantry line against its par level so beans, milk and cups never run dry.

fields.label: New Stock Item
fields.description: Log a pantry line with its par level so a low bag of beans never surprises the morning rush.

properties.placeholder: e.g. House blend beans, Oat milk

forms.title: Roster Shift
forms.description: Roster a crew member onto a date, start and finish times, and a station.

fields.label: New Roster Shift
fields.description: Put someone on the roster: pick the day, the hours and the station they will run.

forms.title: Daily Close
forms.description: Ring off the day with the register total, tips, usage and the cleaning checklist.

fields.label: New Daily Close
fields.description: Close down the cafe: count the register, share the tips and tick off the cleaning list.

blocks.title: Cafe service overview
blocks.body: This report summarises how the cafe is trading: how orders flow through the board, what the baristas are pouring, how the pantry is holding against par, and what the register is ringing off at close. Use it for the weekly ops check-in or a quick owner briefing.
